name: @gofastr/formbuilder-bundle
description: In-frame form-schema builder for the GoFastr formbuilder plugin. Builds a single IIFE (no third-party code) that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage: the schema it edits is DATA ONLY, every save crosses the bridge to the host, and Go validates it before persisting.
